dialogue.speaker: Thomas Thorne
dialogue.text: Hello Sarah. Our guild of independent craftsmen wants to allow members to sell digital craft patterns and physical pottery workshops through our portal.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah Jenkins
dialogue.text: Great. What payment methods and currency will you be accepting?

dialogue.speaker: Thomas Thorne
dialogue.text: We need Stripe credit card processing and PayPal Standard. The platform currency should be USD with monthly recurring membership billing for artisan accounts at $25/mo.

dialogue.speaker: Thomas Thorne
dialogue.text: Whenever an artisan receives an order, they must get an instant automated email invoice and we want an SMS notification via Twilio if possible.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah Jenkins
dialogue.text: Understood. Email templates are built-in natively. For Twilio SMS, we can connect the order webhook trigger to Zapier.
